<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Richtet den Domain Controller des Exchange-Labs ein.

.DESCRIPTION
    Laeuft als Azure Managed Run Command (LocalSystem) auf der DC-VM.

    Phase 'Install' (Standard):
      - Datendisk F: (NTFS) fuer NTDS und SYSVOL (Host-Cache None, siehe Bicep)
      - deutsche Regionaleinstellungen
      - AD DS + DNS, neuer Forest mit Functional Level 2016 (WinThreshold),
        weil Exchange Server SE nur FFL 2012 R2/2016 unterstuetzt
      - registriert einen einmaligen Startup-Task fuer Phase 'PostReboot'
      - verzoegerter Neustart (120 s), damit der Run Command seinen Status melden kann

    Phase 'PostReboot' (einmaliger Startup-Task, SYSTEM, keine Secrets):
      - DNS-Forwarder 168.63.129.16, DNS-Registrierung des DC
      - Split DNS: interne Zone <PublicDomainName> mit mail/autodiscover/MX auf die interne Exchange-IP
      - schreibt Marker und entfernt den Task

    Das Skript ist idempotent und enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'SafeModePasswordB64', Justification = 'Run Command uebergibt Parameter nur als String; Wert ist Base64 und kommt aus protectedParameters.')]
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText', '', Justification = 'Passwort kommt als protectedParameter und wird nur fuer Install-ADDSForest benoetigt.')]
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $NetbiosName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $PublicDomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $ExchangeIp,

    [string] $SafeModePasswordB64,

    [ValidateSet('Install', 'PostReboot')]
    [string] $Phase = 'Install'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$ScriptDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Scripts'
$TaskName = 'ExchangeLab-CompleteDomainController'
$MarkerFile = Join-Path $LabRoot 'dc-ready.txt'
$SelfText = $MyInvocation.MyCommand.ScriptBlock.ToString()

New-Item -Path $LogDir, $ScriptDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir "Install-DomainController-$Phase.log"

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date), $Phase, $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function ConvertFrom-Base64String {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Value)
    [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($Value))
}

function Initialize-DataDisk {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $DriveLetter,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('NTFS', 'ReFS')][string] $FileSystem,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Label
    )

    if (Get-Volume -DriveLetter $DriveLetter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Write-LabLog "Laufwerk ${DriveLetter}: existiert bereits, Datendisk wird nicht neu formatiert."
        return
    }

    # Ein evtl. vorhandenes DVD-Laufwerk darf den Buchstaben nicht blockieren.
    $cdrom = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Volume -Filter "DriveType = 5 AND DriveLetter = '${DriveLetter}:'"
    if ($cdrom) {
        Write-LabLog "DVD-Laufwerk belegt ${DriveLetter}: und wird nach Z: verschoben."
        Set-CimInstance -InputObject $cdrom -Property @{ DriveLetter = 'Z:' }
    }

    $disk = Get-Disk | Where-Object PartitionStyle -EQ 'RAW' | Sort-Object Number | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $disk) {
        throw 'Keine uninitialisierte Datendisk gefunden.'
    }

    Write-LabLog "Initialisiere Disk $($disk.Number) als ${DriveLetter}: ($FileSystem, Label $Label)."
    Initialize-Disk -Number $disk.Number -PartitionStyle GPT
    New-Partition -DiskNumber $disk.Number -UseMaximumSize -DriveLetter $DriveLetter | Out-Null
    Format-Volume -DriveLetter $DriveLetter -FileSystem $FileSystem -NewFileSystemLabel $Label -Confirm:$false | Out-Null
}

function Initialize-RegionalSetting {
    Write-LabLog 'Setze deutsche Regionaleinstellungen (Zeitzone, Gebietsschema, Tastatur).'
    Set-TimeZone -Id 'W. Europe Standard Time'
    Set-WinSystemLocale -SystemLocale de-DE
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId 94
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo de-DE
    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList de-DE -Force
    if (Get-Command -Name Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        # Uebernimmt die Einstellungen fuer Anmeldebildschirm und neue Benutzerprofile.
        Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -WelcomeScreen $true -NewUser $true
    }
}

function Save-OwnScript {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Destination)
    if ($PSCommandPath -and (Test-Path -Path $PSCommandPath)) {
        Copy-Item -Path $PSCommandPath -Destination $Destination -Force
    }
    else {
        Set-Content -Path $Destination -Value $SelfText -Encoding ASCII
    }
}

function Add-SplitDnsRecord {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Zone,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Name,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('A', 'CNAME', 'MX')][string] $Type,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Value
    )

    $existing = Get-DnsServerResourceRecord -ZoneName $Zone -Name $Name -RRType $Type -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($existing) {
        Write-LabLog "DNS-Record $Type $Name.$Zone existiert bereits."
        return
    }

    switch ($Type) {
        'A' { Add-DnsServerResourceRecordA -ZoneName $Zone -Name $Name -IPv4Address $Value }
        'CNAME' { Add-DnsServerResourceRecordCName -ZoneName $Zone -Name $Name -HostNameAlias $Value }
        'MX' { Add-DnsServerResourceRecordMX -ZoneName $Zone -Name $Name -MailExchange $Value -Preference 10 }
    }
    Write-LabLog "DNS-Record $Type $Name.$Zone -> $Value angelegt."
}

function Invoke-InstallPhase {
    if ((Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole -ge 4) {
        Write-LabLog 'Server ist bereits Domain Controller, nichts zu tun.'
        return
    }

    if (-not $SafeModePasswordB64) {
        throw 'SafeModePasswordB64 fehlt.'
    }

    Initialize-DataDisk -DriveLetter 'F' -FileSystem NTFS -Label 'ADDS'
    Initialize-RegionalSetting

    Write-LabLog 'Installiere AD DS und DNS.'
    $feature = Install-WindowsFeature -Name AD-Domain-Services, DNS -IncludeManagementTools
    if (-not $feature.Success) {
        throw 'Installation von AD-Domain-Services/DNS fehlgeschlagen.'
    }

    # Erst Registrierung des Startup-Tasks, dann Heraufstufung: so laeuft PostReboot garantiert nach dem Neustart.
    $scriptCopy = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'Install-DomainController.ps1'
    Save-OwnScript -Destination $scriptCopy
    $arguments = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "{0}" -Phase PostReboot -DomainName {1} -NetbiosName {2} -PublicDomainName {3} -ExchangeIp {4}' -f $scriptCopy, $DomainName, $NetbiosName, $PublicDomainName, $ExchangeIp
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument $arguments
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup
    $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 2) -StartWhenAvailable
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
    Write-LabLog "Startup-Task $TaskName registriert."

    $safeModePassword = ConvertTo-SecureString -String (ConvertFrom-Base64String $SafeModePasswordB64) -AsPlainText -Force
    Import-Module ADDSDeployment

    Write-LabLog "Lege Forest $DomainName (NetBIOS $NetbiosName, Functional Level 2016) an."
    $forestParams = @{
        DomainName                    = $DomainName
        DomainNetbiosName             = $NetbiosName
        ForestMode                    = 'WinThreshold'
        DomainMode                    = 'WinThreshold'
        InstallDns                    = $true
        DatabasePath                  = 'F:\NTDS'
        LogPath                       = 'F:\NTDS'
        SysvolPath                    = 'F:\SYSVOL'
        SafeModeAdministratorPassword = $safeModePassword
        NoRebootOnCompletion          = $true
        Force                         = $true
        WarningAction                 = 'SilentlyContinue'
    }
    $result = Install-ADDSForest @forestParams
    if ($result.Status -ne 'Success') {
        throw "Install-ADDSForest meldet Status '$($result.Status)': $($result.Message)"
    }

    # Der erste DC nutzt sich selbst als DNS-Server.
    $adapter = Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object Status -EQ 'Up' | Select-Object -First 1
    Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $adapter.ifIndex -ServerAddresses '127.0.0.1'
    Write-LabLog "DNS-Client von Adapter $($adapter.Name) zeigt auf 127.0.0.1."

    Write-LabLog 'Forest angelegt. Neustart in 120 Sekunden.'
    & shutdown.exe /r /t 120 /c 'ExchangeLab: Neustart nach DC-Heraufstufung' /d p:4:2 | Out-Null
}

function Invoke-PostRebootPhase {
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(30)
    while ($true) {
        try {
            if ((Get-Service -Name NTDS).Status -eq 'Running' -and (Get-Service -Name DNS).Status -eq 'Running') {
                Import-Module ActiveDirectory
                Get-ADDomain -Identity $DomainName | Out-Null
                break
            }
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "AD noch nicht bereit: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            throw 'AD DS/DNS nach 30 Minuten nicht bereit.'
        }
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
    }
    Write-LabLog 'AD DS und DNS laufen.'

    Set-DnsServerForwarder -IPAddress '168.63.129.16'
    Write-LabLog 'DNS-Forwarder 168.63.129.16 (Azure DNS) gesetzt.'

    & ipconfig.exe /registerdns | Out-Null
    & nltest.exe /dsregdns | Out-Null
    Write-LabLog 'DNS-Registrierung des DC angestossen.'

    if (-not (Get-DnsServerZone -Name $PublicDomainName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        Add-DnsServerPrimaryZone -Name $PublicDomainName -ReplicationScope Domain
        Write-LabLog "Split-DNS-Zone $PublicDomainName angelegt."
    }
    Add-SplitDnsRecord -Zone $PublicDomainName -Name 'mail' -Type A -Value $ExchangeIp
    Add-SplitDnsRecord -Zone $PublicDomainName -Name 'autodiscover' -Type CNAME -Value "mail.$PublicDomainName."
    Add-SplitDnsRecord -Zone $PublicDomainName -Name '.' -Type MX -Value "mail.$PublicDomainName."

    Set-Content -Path $MarkerFile -Value (Get-Date -Format o) -Encoding ASCII
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-LabLog 'Domain Controller fertig eingerichtet, Startup-Task entfernt.'
}

try {
    Write-LabLog "Start (Domain $DomainName)."
    switch ($Phase) {
        'Install' { Invoke-InstallPhase }
        'PostReboot' { Invoke-PostRebootPhase }
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Ende ohne Fehler.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    Write-LabLog $_.ScriptStackTrace
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Bereitet die Exchange-VM vor dem Domaenenbeitritt vor.

.DESCRIPTION
    Laeuft als Azure Managed Run Command (LocalSystem) parallel zum Aufbau des Domain Controllers.
    Startet keinen Neustart: offene Neustarts erledigt der anschliessende Domaenenbeitritt.

      - Auslagerungsdatei fest auf 25 % RAM (Vorgabe Exchange Server SE)
      - Datendisk F: als ReFS (64K, Integrity Streams aus) fuer Datenbanken und Logs
      - deutsche Regionaleinstellungen
      - Windows-Features laut Exchange-SE-Voraussetzungen (Mailbox-Rolle, ohne ADLDS)
      - Remote Registry auf Automatisch (Exchange-Voraussetzung)
      - winget (Modul Microsoft.WinGet.Client, im SYSTEM-Kontext supportet):
        VC++ 2012/2013, IIS URL Rewrite und optionale Tools
      - Exchange-SE-ISO laden und entpacken, UCMA 4.0 aus \UCMARedist installieren
      - optional Let's-Encrypt-Wildcard-Zertifikat ueber die Managed Identity der VM

    Das Skript ist idempotent und enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $PublicDomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $IsoUri,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $SubscriptionId,

    # Komma-getrennte winget-Paket-IDs fuer optionale Tools.
    [string] $WingetPackages = '',

    [ValidateSet('true', 'false')]
    [string] $EnableLetsEncrypt = 'true',

    [ValidateSet('true', 'false')]
    [string] $LetsEncryptStaging = 'false'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$InstallDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Install'
$MediaDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Media\ExchangeSE'
$CertDir = 'C:\Certificates'
$PoshAcmeHome = 'C:\ProgramData\Posh-ACME'

New-Item -Path $LogDir, $InstallDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir 'Initialize-ExchangeServer.log'

# Voraussetzungen fuer Exchange Server SE (Mailbox, Desktop Experience), Quelle:
# https://learn.microsoft.com/exchange/plan-and-deploy/prerequisites
$ExchangeWindowsFeatures = @(
    'Server-Media-Foundation', 'NET-Framework-45-Core', 'NET-Framework-45-ASPNET', 'NET-WCF-HTTP-Activation45',
    'NET-WCF-Pipe-Activation45', 'NET-WCF-TCP-Activation45', 'NET-WCF-TCP-PortSharing45', 'RPC-over-HTTP-proxy',
    'RSAT-Clustering', 'RSAT-Clustering-CmdInterface', 'RSAT-Clustering-Mgmt', 'RSAT-Clustering-PowerShell',
    'WAS-Process-Model', 'Web-Asp-Net45', 'Web-Basic-Auth', 'Web-Client-Auth', 'Web-Digest-Auth', 'Web-Dir-Browsing',
    'Web-Dyn-Compression', 'Web-Http-Errors', 'Web-Http-Logging', 'Web-Http-Redirect', 'Web-Http-Tracing',
    'Web-ISAPI-Ext', 'Web-ISAPI-Filter', 'Web-Metabase', 'Web-Mgmt-Console', 'Web-Mgmt-Service', 'Web-Net-Ext45',
    'Web-Request-Monitor', 'Web-Server', 'Web-Stat-Compression', 'Web-Static-Content', 'Web-Windows-Auth', 'Web-WMI',
    'Windows-Identity-Foundation', 'RSAT-ADDS', 'RSAT-AD-PowerShell'
)

# Pflicht-Pakete. Fallback-Daten (URL, SHA256) stammen aus den winget-Manifesten.
$RequiredPackages = @(
    @{
        Id        = 'Microsoft.VCRedist.2012.x64'
        Url       = 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/1/6/B/16B06F60-3B20-4FF2-B699-5E9B7962F9AE/VSU_4/vcredist_x64.exe'
        Sha256    = '681be3e5ba9fd3da02c09d7e565adfa078640ed66a0d58583efad2c1e3cc4064'
        Arguments = '/install /quiet /norestart'
    }
    @{
        Id        = 'Microsoft.VCRedist.2013.x64'
        Url       = 'https://download.visualstudio.microsoft.com/download/pr/10912041/cee5d6bca2ddbcd039da727bf4acb48a/vcredist_x64.exe'
        Sha256    = 'a4bba7701e355ae29c403431f871a537897c363e215cafe706615e270984f17c'
        Arguments = '/install /quiet /norestart'
    }
    @{
        Id        = 'Microsoft.IIS.URLRewrite'
        Url       = 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/1/2/8/128E2E22-C1B9-44A4-BE2A-5859ED1D4592/rewrite_amd64_en-US.msi'
        Sha256    = '37342ff2f585f263f34f48e9de59eb1051d61015a8e967dbde4075716230a32a'
        Arguments = '/quiet /norestart'
    }
)

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Invoke-WithRetry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock] $ScriptBlock,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Activity,
        [int] $Attempts = 3,
        [int] $DelaySeconds = 30
    )
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Attempts; $i++) {
        try {
            return & $ScriptBlock
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "$Activity - Versuch $i/$Attempts fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            if ($i -eq $Attempts) { throw }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
        }
    }
}

function Initialize-PageFile {
    $computerSystem = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem
    $sizeMb = [uint32][math]::Floor($computerSystem.TotalPhysicalMemory / 1MB * 0.25)

    if ($computerSystem.AutomaticManagedPagefile) {
        Set-CimInstance -InputObject $computerSystem -Property @{ AutomaticManagedPagefile = $false }
    }
    Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileSetting | Where-Object Name -NE 'C:\pagefile.sys' | Remove-CimInstance
    $setting = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileSetting | Where-Object Name -EQ 'C:\pagefile.sys'
    if ($setting) {
        Set-CimInstance -InputObject $setting -Property @{ InitialSize = $sizeMb; MaximumSize = $sizeMb }
    }
    else {
        New-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileSetting -Property @{ Name = 'C:\pagefile.sys'; InitialSize = $sizeMb; MaximumSize = $sizeMb } | Out-Null
    }
    Write-LabLog "Auslagerungsdatei C:\pagefile.sys fest auf $sizeMb MB (25 % RAM)."
}

function Initialize-DataDisk {
    if (Get-Volume -DriveLetter 'F' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Write-LabLog 'Laufwerk F: existiert bereits.'
        return
    }

    $cdrom = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Volume -Filter "DriveType = 5 AND DriveLetter = 'F:'"
    if ($cdrom) {
        Set-CimInstance -InputObject $cdrom -Property @{ DriveLetter = 'Z:' }
    }

    $disk = Get-Disk | Where-Object PartitionStyle -EQ 'RAW' | Sort-Object Number | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $disk) {
        throw 'Keine uninitialisierte Datendisk gefunden.'
    }

    Initialize-Disk -Number $disk.Number -PartitionStyle GPT
    New-Partition -DiskNumber $disk.Number -UseMaximumSize -DriveLetter 'F' | Out-Null
    Format-Volume -DriveLetter 'F' -FileSystem ReFS -AllocationUnitSize 65536 -SetIntegrityStreams $false -NewFileSystemLabel 'ExchangeData' -Confirm:$false | Out-Null
    Write-LabLog "Datendisk $($disk.Number) als F: (ReFS, 64K, Integrity Streams aus) formatiert."
}

function Initialize-RegionalSetting {
    Set-TimeZone -Id 'W. Europe Standard Time'
    Set-WinSystemLocale -SystemLocale de-DE
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId 94
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo de-DE
    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList de-DE -Force
    if (Get-Command -Name Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -WelcomeScreen $true -NewUser $true
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Deutsche Regionaleinstellungen gesetzt.'
}

function Install-ExchangeWindowsFeature {
    $result = Install-WindowsFeature -Name $ExchangeWindowsFeatures
    if (-not $result.Success) {
        throw 'Installation der Windows-Features fuer Exchange fehlgeschlagen.'
    }
    Write-LabLog "Windows-Features installiert (Neustart erforderlich: $($result.RestartNeeded))."

    Set-Service -Name RemoteRegistry -StartupType Automatic
    Start-Service -Name RemoteRegistry
    Write-LabLog 'Remote Registry auf Automatisch gesetzt und gestartet.'
}

function Initialize-PowerShellGallery {
    if (-not (Get-PackageProvider -ListAvailable -Name NuGet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Version -GE '2.8.5.201')) {
        Install-PackageProvider -Name NuGet -MinimumVersion '2.8.5.201' -Force -Scope AllUsers | Out-Null
    }
    Set-PSRepository -Name PSGallery -InstallationPolicy Trusted
}

function Initialize-WinGet {
    Initialize-PowerShellGallery
    if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name Microsoft.WinGet.Client)) {
        Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Install-Module Microsoft.WinGet.Client' -ScriptBlock {
            Install-Module -Name Microsoft.WinGet.Client -Scope AllUsers -Force
        }
    }
    Import-Module -Name Microsoft.WinGet.Client

    try {
        Write-LabLog "WinGet-Version: $(Get-WinGetVersion)"
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WinGet nicht bereit ($($_.Exception.Message)), repariere Paketmanager."
        Repair-WinGetPackageManager -AllUsers -Force -Latest
        Write-LabLog "WinGet-Version nach Reparatur: $(Get-WinGetVersion)"
    }
}

function Install-PackageFromDownload {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable] $Package)

    $fileName = Split-Path -Path $Package.Url -Leaf
    $target = Join-Path $InstallDir ("{0}-{1}" -f $Package.Id, $fileName)
    Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Download $($Package.Id)" -ScriptBlock {
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Package.Url -OutFile $target -UseBasicParsing
    }

    $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    if ($hash -ne $Package.Sha256) {
        throw "SHA256 von $($Package.Id) passt nicht (erwartet $($Package.Sha256), erhalten $hash)."
    }

    if ($target -like '*.msi') {
        $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'msiexec.exe' -ArgumentList "/i `"$target`" $($Package.Arguments)" -Wait -PassThru
    }
    else {
        $process = Start-Process -FilePath $target -ArgumentList $Package.Arguments -Wait -PassThru
    }
    if ($process.ExitCode -notin 0, 1638, 3010) {
        throw "Installation von $($Package.Id) per Download fehlgeschlagen (Exit-Code $($process.ExitCode))."
    }
    Write-LabLog "$($Package.Id) per Microsoft-Download installiert (Exit-Code $($process.ExitCode))."
}

function Install-LabPackage {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Id,
        [hashtable] $Fallback
    )

    try {
        $result = Install-WinGetPackage -Id $Id -Source winget -MatchOption Equals -Mode Silent -Scope SystemOrUnknown -Force
        if ($result.Status -ne 'Ok') {
            throw "Status $($result.Status), Installer-Code $($result.InstallerErrorCode)"
        }
        Write-LabLog "winget: $Id installiert (Neustart erforderlich: $($result.RebootRequired))."
    }
    catch {
        if (-not $Fallback) {
            throw "winget-Installation von $Id fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
        Write-LabLog "winget-Installation von $Id fehlgeschlagen ($($_.Exception.Message)), nutze Microsoft-Download."
        Install-PackageFromDownload -Package $Fallback
    }
}

function Install-LabSoftware {
    $wingetReady = $true
    try {
        Initialize-WinGet
    }
    catch {
        $wingetReady = $false
        Write-LabLog "WinGet nicht verfuegbar: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }

    foreach ($package in $RequiredPackages) {
        if ($wingetReady) {
            Install-LabPackage -Id $package.Id -Fallback $package
        }
        else {
            Install-PackageFromDownload -Package $package
        }
    }

    $optional = $WingetPackages.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ }
    foreach ($id in $optional) {
        if (-not $wingetReady) {
            Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: $id uebersprungen, WinGet nicht verfuegbar."
            continue
        }
        try {
            Install-LabPackage -Id $id
        }
        catch {
            # Optionale Tools duerfen das Lab nicht blockieren.
            Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

function Get-ExchangeMedium {
    $setupExe = Join-Path $MediaDir 'Setup.exe'
    if (Test-Path -Path $setupExe) {
        Write-LabLog "Exchange-Medium bereits vorhanden: $setupExe"
        return
    }

    $isoPath = Join-Path $InstallDir (Split-Path -Path $IsoUri -Leaf)
    if (-not (Test-Path -Path $isoPath)) {
        Write-LabLog "Lade Exchange-ISO von $IsoUri."
        Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Download Exchange-ISO' -Attempts 3 -DelaySeconds 60 -ScriptBlock {
            try {
                Start-BitsTransfer -Source $IsoUri -Destination $isoPath -Priority Foreground
            }
            catch {
                # BITS ist im SYSTEM-Kontext nicht immer verfuegbar.
                Write-LabLog "BITS nicht nutzbar ($($_.Exception.Message)), lade per WebClient."
                $client = New-Object -TypeName System.Net.WebClient
                try { $client.DownloadFile($IsoUri, $isoPath) } finally { $client.Dispose() }
            }
        }
    }

    Write-LabLog 'Entpacke Exchange-ISO.'
    $image = Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath $isoPath -PassThru
    try {
        $driveLetter = ($image | Get-Volume).DriveLetter
        New-Item -Path $MediaDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
        & robocopy.exe "${driveLetter}:\" $MediaDir /E /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) {
            throw "robocopy meldet Exit-Code $LASTEXITCODE."
        }
    }
    finally {
        Dismount-DiskImage -ImagePath $isoPath | Out-Null
    }
    Remove-Item -Path $isoPath -Force

    $version = (Get-Item -Path $setupExe).VersionInfo.ProductVersion
    Write-LabLog "Exchange-Medium bereit, Setup-Version $version."
}

function Install-Ucma {
    $installed = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -like '*Unified Communications Managed API 4.0*' }
    if ($installed) {
        Write-LabLog 'UCMA 4.0 bereits installiert.'
        return
    }

    $ucmaSetup = Join-Path $MediaDir 'UCMARedist\Setup.exe'
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $ucmaSetup -ArgumentList '/quiet /norestart' -Wait -PassThru
    if ($process.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010) {
        throw "UCMA-Installation fehlgeschlagen (Exit-Code $($process.ExitCode))."
    }
    Write-LabLog "UCMA 4.0 installiert (Exit-Code $($process.ExitCode))."
}

function Request-LabCertificate {
    if ($EnableLetsEncrypt -ne 'true') {
        Write-LabLog "Let's Encrypt deaktiviert, kein Zertifikat angefordert."
        return
    }

    try {
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('POSHACME_HOME', $PoshAcmeHome, 'Machine')
        $env:POSHACME_HOME = $PoshAcmeHome
        New-Item -Path $PoshAcmeHome, $CertDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null

        Initialize-PowerShellGallery
        if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name Posh-ACME)) {
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Install-Module Posh-ACME' -ScriptBlock {
                Install-Module -Name Posh-ACME -Scope AllUsers -Force
            }
        }
        Import-Module -Name Posh-ACME

        if ($LetsEncryptStaging -eq 'true') { Set-PAServer -DirectoryUrl LE_STAGE } else { Set-PAServer -DirectoryUrl LE_PROD }

        $domain = "*.$PublicDomainName"
        $certificate = Get-PACertificate -MainDomain $domain -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if (-not $certificate -or $certificate.NotAfter -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(30)) {
            $pluginArgs = @{ AZSubscriptionId = $SubscriptionId; AZUseIMDS = $true }
            # Mehrere Versuche: die Rollenzuweisung der Managed Identity kann einige Minuten brauchen.
            $certificate = Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Let's-Encrypt-Zertifikat $domain" -Attempts 5 -DelaySeconds 120 -ScriptBlock {
                New-PACertificate -Domain $domain -AcceptTOS -Plugin Azure -PluginArgs $pluginArgs -Force
            }
        }

        foreach ($file in @($certificate.CertFile, $certificate.KeyFile, $certificate.ChainFile, $certificate.FullChainFile, $certificate.PfxFile, $certificate.PfxFullChain)) {
            if ($file -and (Test-Path -Path $file)) {
                Copy-Item -Path $file -Destination $CertDir -Force
            }
        }
        # Privater Schluessel: nur Administratoren und SYSTEM.
        & icacls.exe $CertDir /inheritance:r /grant:r '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' | Out-Null
        Write-LabLog "Zertifikat $domain (gueltig bis $($certificate.NotAfter)) nach $CertDir kopiert."
    }
    catch {
        # Nicht fatal: Exchange laeuft mit dem selbstsignierten Zertifikat weiter.
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Let's-Encrypt-Zertifikat konnte nicht erstellt werden: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $LabRoot 'letsencrypt-failed.txt') -Value $_.Exception.Message -Encoding ASCII
    }
}

try {
    Write-LabLog "Start (oeffentliche Domain $PublicDomainName)."
    Initialize-PageFile
    Initialize-DataDisk
    Initialize-RegionalSetting
    Install-ExchangeWindowsFeature
    Install-LabSoftware
    Get-ExchangeMedium
    Install-Ucma
    Request-LabCertificate
    Write-LabLog 'Ende ohne Fehler.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    Write-LabLog $_.ScriptStackTrace
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Wartet auf der Exchange-VM, bis der Domain Controller vollstaendig bereit ist.

.DESCRIPTION
    Laeuft als Azure Managed Run Command (LocalSystem) vor dem Domaenenbeitritt.
    Erneuert die DHCP-Lease (neuer DNS-Server aus dem VNet) und prueft in einer Schleife:
      - DNS-Server der VM ist der DC
      - SRV-Record _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.<Domain> ist aufloesbar
      - Split-DNS-Record mail.<PublicDomainName> zeigt auf die Exchange-IP (PostReboot-Phase des DC fertig)
      - LDAP-Bind mit dem Domain-Admin funktioniert

    Das Skript enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'AdminPasswordB64', Justification = 'Run Command uebergibt Parameter nur als String; Wert ist Base64 und kommt aus protectedParameters.')]
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingUsernameAndPasswordParams', '', Justification = 'Run Command kann keine PSCredential uebergeben.')]
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $NetbiosName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $AdminUser,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $AdminPasswordB64,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DcIp,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $PublicDomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $ExchangeIp,

    [int] $TimeoutMinutes = 45
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

$LogDir = 'C:\ExchangeLab\Logs'
New-Item -Path $LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir 'Wait-DomainController.log'

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Test-DomainControllerReady {
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'Password', Justification = 'DirectoryEntry erwartet das Passwort als String.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Password)

    $dnsServers = (Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object ServerAddresses).ServerAddresses
    if ($dnsServers -notcontains $DcIp) {
        return "DNS-Server der VM ($($dnsServers -join ', ')) enthaelt den DC $DcIp noch nicht."
    }

    $srv = Resolve-DnsName -Name "_ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.$DomainName" -Type SRV -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not ($srv | Where-Object Type -EQ 'SRV')) {
        return "SRV-Record fuer $DomainName noch nicht aufloesbar."
    }

    $mail = Resolve-DnsName -Name "mail.$PublicDomainName" -Type A -Server $DcIp -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (($mail | Where-Object Type -EQ 'A').IPAddress -notcontains $ExchangeIp) {
        return "Split-DNS-Record mail.$PublicDomainName zeigt noch nicht auf $ExchangeIp."
    }

    $entry = New-Object -TypeName System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry -ArgumentList "LDAP://$DomainName/RootDSE", "$NetbiosName\$AdminUser", $Password
    try {
        $namingContext = $entry.Properties['defaultNamingContext'].Value
        if (-not $namingContext) {
            return 'LDAP-Bind liefert keinen Naming Context.'
        }
    }
    finally {
        $entry.Dispose()
    }

    return $null
}

try {
    $password = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($AdminPasswordB64))

    Write-LabLog 'Erneuere DHCP-Lease (DNS-Server aus dem VNet).'
    & ipconfig.exe /renew | Out-Null

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($TimeoutMinutes)
    while ($true) {
        Clear-DnsClientCache
        try {
            $reason = Test-DomainControllerReady -Password $password
        }
        catch {
            $reason = $_.Exception.Message
        }

        if (-not $reason) {
            break
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            throw "Domain Controller nach $TimeoutMinutes Minuten nicht bereit: $reason"
        }
        Write-LabLog "Warte: $reason"
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
    }

    Write-LabLog "Domain Controller fuer $DomainName ist bereit."
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Installiert und konfiguriert Exchange Server SE auf der Lab-VM.

.DESCRIPTION
    Phase 'Orchestrate' (Standard, Azure Managed Run Command als LocalSystem):
      - wartet, bis der Domaenenbeitritt inkl. Neustart abgeschlossen ist
      - legt Secrets DPAPI-geschuetzt ab und startet Phase 'Install' als Scheduled Task
        unter dem Domain-Admin mit hoechsten Rechten (volles Admin-Token fuer Exchange-Setup)
      - wartet auf das Ergebnis, raeumt Task und Secrets auf, startet den Server verzoegert neu

    Phase 'Install' (Scheduled Task als <NETBIOS>\<AdminUser>):
      - OU-Struktur und Lab-Benutzer aus LabUsers.psd1, UPN-Suffix der oeffentlichen Domain
      - Pruefung DC-Build (Windows Server 2025 braucht fuer PrepareSchema mind. 26100.7171)
      - Exchange-Setup: PrepareSchema, PrepareAD, Mailbox-Rolle (DB und Logs auf F:)
      - Nachkonfiguration: Accepted Domain, Adressrichtlinie, Postfaecher, Zertifikat (IIS/SMTP),
        interne/externe URLs, Autodiscover-SCP
      - registriert den einmaligen Update-Task auf Exchange-Server und DC

    Das Skript ist idempotent und enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'AdminPasswordB64', Justification = 'Run Command uebergibt Parameter nur als String; Wert ist Base64 und kommt aus protectedParameters.')]
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'LabUserPasswordB64', Justification = 'Run Command uebergibt Parameter nur als String; Wert ist Base64 und kommt aus protectedParameters.')]
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText', '', Justification = 'Passwoerter kommen als protectedParameters bzw. DPAPI-geschuetzt und werden nur lokal verwendet.')]
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingUsernameAndPasswordParams', '', Justification = 'Run Command kann keine PSCredential uebergeben.')]
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $NetbiosName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $AdminUser,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $PublicDomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $CompanyOu,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DcComputerName,

    [string] $OrganizationName = 'ExchOrg',

    # Nur Phase 'Orchestrate':
    [string] $AdminPasswordB64,
    [string] $LabUserPasswordB64,
    [string] $LabUsersB64,
    [string] $UpdateScriptB64,

    [ValidateSet('Orchestrate', 'Install')]
    [string] $Phase = 'Orchestrate',

    [int] $TimeoutMinutes = 140
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$ScriptDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Scripts'
$SecretDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Secrets'
$SecretFile = Join-Path $SecretDir 'install.dat'
$ResultFile = Join-Path $LabRoot 'exchange-install.result'
$DoneMarker = Join-Path $LabRoot 'exchange-install.done'
$LabUsersFile = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'LabUsers.psd1'
$UpdateScriptFile = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'Update-LabServer.ps1'
$MediaDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Media\ExchangeSE'
$CertDir = 'C:\Certificates'
$InstallTaskName = 'ExchangeLab-InstallExchange'
$UpdateTaskName = 'ExchangeLab-InitialUpdates'
$PfxPassword = 'poshacme'
$SelfText = $MyInvocation.MyCommand.ScriptBlock.ToString()

New-Item -Path $LogDir, $ScriptDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir "Install-ExchangeServer-$Phase.log"

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date), $Phase, $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function ConvertFrom-Base64String {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Value)
    [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($Value))
}

function Invoke-WithRetry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock] $ScriptBlock,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Activity,
        [int] $Attempts = 3,
        [int] $DelaySeconds = 30
    )
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Attempts; $i++) {
        try {
            return & $ScriptBlock
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "$Activity - Versuch $i/$Attempts fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            if ($i -eq $Attempts) { throw }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
        }
    }
}

function Write-Utf8File {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Content)
    # Mit BOM, damit Windows PowerShell 5.1 Umlaute korrekt liest.
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.UTF8Encoding -ArgumentList $true))
}

function Protect-Directory {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path)
    New-Item -Path $Path -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    & icacls.exe $Path /inheritance:r /grant:r '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' | Out-Null
}

function Register-LabUpdateTask {
    # Wird lokal und per Invoke-Command auf dem DC ausgefuehrt, daher ohne Abhaengigkeiten.
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $ScriptContent,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $TaskName,
        [bool] $StartNow = $false
    )
    $scriptFolder = 'C:\ExchangeLab\Scripts'
    New-Item -Path $scriptFolder -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    $scriptPath = Join-Path $scriptFolder 'Update-LabServer.ps1'
    Set-Content -Path $scriptPath -Value $ScriptContent -Encoding ASCII

    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$scriptPath`" -TaskName $TaskName"
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup
    $trigger.Delay = 'PT5M'
    $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 4) -StartWhenAvailable
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
    if ($StartNow) {
        Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
    }
}

#region Phase Orchestrate

function Get-PendingRebootReason {
    $reasons = @()
    if (Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending') {
        $reasons += 'Component Based Servicing'
    }
    if (Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired') {
        $reasons += 'Windows Update'
    }
    if (Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\JoinDomain') {
        $reasons += 'Domaenenbeitritt'
    }
    return $reasons
}

function Wait-DomainJoinComplete {
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(30)
    while ($true) {
        $computerSystem = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem
        $joinPending = Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\JoinDomain'
        $secureChannel = $false
        if ($computerSystem.PartOfDomain -and -not $joinPending) {
            try { $secureChannel = Test-ComputerSecureChannel } catch { $secureChannel = $false }
        }
        if ($secureChannel) {
            Write-LabLog "Domaenenbeitritt zu $($computerSystem.Domain) abgeschlossen, Secure Channel ok."
            return
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            throw 'Domaenenbeitritt nach 30 Minuten nicht abgeschlossen.'
        }
        Write-LabLog "Warte auf Domaenenbeitritt (Teil der Domain: $($computerSystem.PartOfDomain), Neustart ausstehend: $joinPending)."
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
    }
}

function Save-InstallSecret {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Security
    Protect-Directory -Path $SecretDir
    $payload = @{
        AdminPassword   = ConvertFrom-Base64String $AdminPasswordB64
        LabUserPassword = ConvertFrom-Base64String $LabUserPasswordB64
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
    $protected = [Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Protect([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload), $null, [Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::LocalMachine)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($SecretFile, $protected)
}

function Save-OwnScript {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Destination)
    if ($PSCommandPath -and (Test-Path -Path $PSCommandPath)) {
        Copy-Item -Path $PSCommandPath -Destination $Destination -Force
    }
    else {
        Set-Content -Path $Destination -Value $SelfText -Encoding ASCII
    }
}

function Invoke-InstallTask {
    $scriptCopy = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'Install-ExchangeServer.ps1'
    Save-OwnScript -Destination $scriptCopy
    Write-Utf8File -Path $LabUsersFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $LabUsersB64)
    Write-Utf8File -Path $UpdateScriptFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $UpdateScriptB64)
    Save-InstallSecret
    Remove-Item -Path $ResultFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $arguments = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "{0}" -Phase Install -DomainName {1} -NetbiosName {2} -AdminUser {3} -PublicDomainName {4} -CompanyOu {5} -DcComputerName {6} -OrganizationName {7}' -f $scriptCopy, $DomainName, $NetbiosName, $AdminUser, $PublicDomainName, $CompanyOu, $DcComputerName, $OrganizationName
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument $arguments
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 3)
    $adminPassword = ConvertFrom-Base64String $AdminPasswordB64
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName -Action $action -Settings $settings -User "$NetbiosName\$AdminUser" -Password $adminPassword -RunLevel Highest -Force | Out-Null
    Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName
    Write-LabLog "Installationsphase als $NetbiosName\$AdminUser gestartet (Task $InstallTaskName)."

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($TimeoutMinutes)
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
    while ((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName).State -eq 'Running') {
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName
            throw "Installationsphase nach $TimeoutMinutes Minuten abgebrochen."
        }
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
    }

    $taskInfo = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $InstallTaskName
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName -Confirm:$false
    Remove-Item -Path $SecretFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $result = if (Test-Path -Path $ResultFile) { (Get-Content -Path $ResultFile -Raw).Trim() } else { 'missing' }
    if ($result -ne '0') {
        $installLog = Join-Path $LogDir 'Install-ExchangeServer-Install.log'
        $tail = Get-Content -Path $installLog -Tail 40 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        throw "Installationsphase fehlgeschlagen (Ergebnis $result, Task-Code $($taskInfo.LastTaskResult)).`n$($tail -join "`n")"
    }
}

function Invoke-OrchestratePhase {
    if (Test-Path -Path $DoneMarker) {
        Write-LabLog 'Exchange ist bereits installiert und konfiguriert, nichts zu tun.'
        return
    }
    foreach ($name in 'AdminPasswordB64', 'LabUserPasswordB64', 'LabUsersB64', 'UpdateScriptB64') {
        if (-not (Get-Variable -Name $name -ValueOnly)) {
            throw "Parameter $name fehlt."
        }
    }

    Wait-DomainJoinComplete
    $pending = Get-PendingRebootReason
    if ($pending) {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Neustart ausstehend ($($pending -join ', ')). Exchange-Setup prueft das selbst."
    }

    Invoke-InstallTask

    Set-Content -Path $DoneMarker -Value (Get-Date -Format o) -Encoding ASCII
    Write-LabLog 'Exchange installiert und konfiguriert. Neustart in 120 Sekunden, danach Update-Lauf.'
    & shutdown.exe /r /t 120 /c 'ExchangeLab: Neustart nach Exchange-Installation' /d p:4:2 | Out-Null
}

#endregion

#region Phase Install

function Get-InstallSecret {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Security
    $bytes = [Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($SecretFile), $null, [Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::LocalMachine)
    [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes) | ConvertFrom-Json
}

function Initialize-LabDirectory {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][securestring] $LabUserPassword)

    Import-Module ActiveDirectory
    $forest = Get-ADForest
    if ($forest.UPNSuffixes -notcontains $PublicDomainName) {
        Set-ADForest -Identity $forest -UPNSuffixes @{ Add = $PublicDomainName }
        Write-LabLog "UPN-Suffix $PublicDomainName hinzugefuegt."
    }

    $domainDn = (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName
    $companyDn = "OU=$CompanyOu,$domainDn"
    if (-not [adsi]::Exists("LDAP://$companyDn")) {
        New-ADOrganizationalUnit -Name $CompanyOu -Path $domainDn
        Write-LabLog "OU $companyDn angelegt."
    }

    $data = Import-PowerShellDataFile -Path $LabUsersFile
    foreach ($relativeOu in $data.OrganizationalUnits) {
        $ouDn = "$relativeOu,$companyDn"
        if ([adsi]::Exists("LDAP://$ouDn")) { continue }
        $parts = $relativeOu -split ',', 2
        $name = $parts[0] -replace '^OU=', ''
        $parentDn = if ($parts.Count -gt 1) { "$($parts[1]),$companyDn" } else { $companyDn }
        New-ADOrganizationalUnit -Name $name -Path $parentDn
        Write-LabLog "OU $ouDn angelegt."
    }

    foreach ($user in $data.Users) {
        $displayName = "$($user.GivenName) $($user.Surname)"
        $attributes = @{
            GivenName         = $user.GivenName
            Surname           = $user.Surname
            DisplayName       = $displayName
            UserPrincipalName = '{0}@{1}' -f $user.SamAccountName.ToLowerInvariant(), $PublicDomainName
            StreetAddress     = $user.StreetAddress
            City              = $user.City
            PostalCode        = $user.PostalCode
            Country           = 'DE'
            Company           = $CompanyOu
            Office            = $user.Office
            Title             = $user.Title
            OfficePhone       = $user.OfficePhone
            MobilePhone       = $user.MobilePhone
        }
        if ($user.Department) { $attributes.Department = $user.Department }

        $existing = Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq '$($user.SamAccountName)'"
        if ($existing) {
            Set-ADUser -Identity $existing @attributes
        }
        else {
            New-ADUser -Name $displayName -SamAccountName $user.SamAccountName -Path "$($user.OrganizationalUnit),$companyDn" -AccountPassword $LabUserPassword -Enabled $true @attributes
            Write-LabLog "Benutzer $($user.SamAccountName) angelegt."
        }
    }
    return $data.Users
}

function Assert-DomainControllerBuild {
    $dcFqdn = "$DcComputerName.$DomainName"
    try {
        $build = Invoke-Command -ComputerName $dcFqdn -ScriptBlock {
            $currentVersion = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
            [pscustomobject]@{ Build = [int]$currentVersion.CurrentBuildNumber; Ubr = [int]$currentVersion.UBR }
        }
    }
    catch {
        # Nur die Pruefung entfaellt; Marketplace-Images "latest" erfuellen die Bedingung.
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Build des DC $dcFqdn nicht pruefbar: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return
    }
    Write-LabLog "DC $dcFqdn hat Build $($build.Build).$($build.Ubr)."
    if ($build.Build -eq 26100 -and $build.Ubr -lt 7171) {
        throw "DC $dcFqdn braucht fuer PrepareSchema mindestens Build 26100.7171 (Update November 2025)."
    }
}

function Invoke-ExchangeSetup {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Step, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]] $Arguments)

    $setupExe = Join-Path $MediaDir 'Setup.exe'
    $allArguments = $Arguments + '/IAcceptExchangeServerLicenseTerms_DiagnosticDataOFF'
    $outFile = Join-Path $LogDir "ExchangeSetup-$Step.out.log"
    Write-LabLog "Exchange-Setup ${Step}: $($allArguments -join ' ')"
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $setupExe -ArgumentList $allArguments -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError "$outFile.err"
    if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        $tail = Get-Content -Path 'C:\ExchangeSetupLogs\ExchangeSetup.log' -Tail 30 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        throw "Exchange-Setup $Step mit Exit-Code $($process.ExitCode) beendet.`n$($tail -join "`n")"
    }
    Write-LabLog "Exchange-Setup $Step erfolgreich."
}

function Install-Exchange {
    if (Get-Service -Name MSExchangeIS -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Write-LabLog 'Exchange ist bereits installiert.'
        return
    }
    Assert-DomainControllerBuild
    Invoke-ExchangeSetup -Step 'PrepareSchema' -Arguments '/PrepareSchema'
    Invoke-ExchangeSetup -Step 'PrepareAD' -Arguments '/PrepareAD', "/OrganizationName:$OrganizationName"
    Invoke-ExchangeSetup -Step 'Install' -Arguments '/Mode:Install', '/Roles:Mailbox', '/MdbName:DB01', '/DbFilePath:F:\ExchangeDatabases\DB01\DB01.edb', '/LogFolderPath:F:\ExchangeDatabases\DB01\Logs'
}

function Connect-ExchangeSession {
    # Neues Kerberos-Ticket, damit die beim PrepareAD vergebene Gruppe "Organization Management" wirkt.
    & klist.exe purge | Out-Null
    $uri = ('http://{0}.{1}/PowerShell/' -f $env:COMPUTERNAME, $DomainName).ToLowerInvariant()
    $session = Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Exchange-PowerShell-Verbindung' -Attempts 20 -DelaySeconds 30 -ScriptBlock {
        New-PSSession -ConfigurationName Microsoft.Exchange -ConnectionUri $uri -Authentication Kerberos
    }
    Import-PSSession -Session $session -DisableNameChecking -AllowClobber | Out-Null
    Write-LabLog "Exchange-PowerShell verbunden ($uri)."
}

function Initialize-ExchangeConfiguration {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]] $Users)

    $server = $env:COMPUTERNAME
    $mailHost = "mail.$PublicDomainName"
    $baseUrl = "https://$mailHost"

    # Accepted Domain und Adressrichtlinie
    if (-not (Get-AcceptedDomain | Where-Object { "$($_.DomainName)" -eq $PublicDomainName })) {
        New-AcceptedDomain -Name $PublicDomainName -DomainName $PublicDomainName -DomainType Authoritative | Out-Null
    }
    Set-AcceptedDomain -Identity $PublicDomainName -MakeDefault $true
    $policy = Get-EmailAddressPolicy | Where-Object { "$($_.Priority)" -eq 'Lowest' } | Select-Object -First 1
    Set-EmailAddressPolicy -Identity $policy.Name -EnabledEmailAddressTemplates "SMTP:%m@$PublicDomainName", "smtp:%m@$DomainName"
    Update-EmailAddressPolicy -Identity $policy.Name
    Write-LabLog "Accepted Domain $PublicDomainName ist Standard, Adressrichtlinie '$($policy.Name)' angewendet."

    # Postfaecher
    $database = (Get-MailboxDatabase -Server $server | Select-Object -First 1).Name
    foreach ($user in $Users) {
        $upn = '{0}@{1}' -f $user.SamAccountName.ToLowerInvariant(), $PublicDomainName
        $recipient = Get-User -Identity $upn
        if ("$($recipient.RecipientType)" -ne 'UserMailbox') {
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Enable-Mailbox $upn" -Attempts 5 -DelaySeconds 30 -ScriptBlock {
                Enable-Mailbox -Identity $upn -Database $database | Out-Null
            }
            Write-LabLog "Postfach fuer $upn angelegt."
        }
    }

    # Zertifikat
    $pfxFile = Join-Path $CertDir 'fullchain.pfx'
    if (Test-Path -Path $pfxFile) {
        $certificate = New-Object -TypeName System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2 -ArgumentList $pfxFile, $PfxPassword
        $thumbprint = $certificate.Thumbprint
        if (-not (Get-ExchangeCertificate -Server $server | Where-Object { $_.Thumbprint -eq $thumbprint })) {
            Import-ExchangeCertificate -Server $server -FileData ([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pfxFile)) -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString -String $PfxPassword -AsPlainText -Force) -PrivateKeyExportable $true | Out-Null
        }
        Enable-ExchangeCertificate -Server $server -Thumbprint $thumbprint -Services 'IIS,SMTP' -Force -Confirm:$false
        Write-LabLog "Zertifikat $($certificate.Subject) ($thumbprint, gueltig bis $($certificate.NotAfter)) fuer IIS und SMTP aktiviert."
    }
    else {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: $pfxFile fehlt, Exchange nutzt weiter das selbstsignierte Zertifikat."
    }

    # Interne und externe URLs
    Set-OwaVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\owa (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/owa" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/owa"
    Set-EcpVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\ecp (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/ecp" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/ecp"
    Set-WebServicesVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\EWS (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/EWS/Exchange.asmx" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/EWS/Exchange.asmx"
    Set-OabVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\OAB (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/OAB" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/OAB"
    Set-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync"
    Set-MapiVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\mapi (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/mapi" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/mapi"
    Set-OutlookAnywhere -Identity "$server\Rpc (Default Web Site)" -InternalHostname $mailHost -ExternalHostname $mailHost -InternalClientsRequireSsl $true -ExternalClientsRequireSsl $true
    Set-ClientAccessService -Identity $server -AutoDiscoverServiceInternalUri "https://autodiscover.$PublicDomainName/Autodiscover/Autodiscover.xml"
    Write-LabLog "Interne und externe URLs auf $baseUrl gesetzt, Autodiscover-SCP konfiguriert."
}

function Register-InitialUpdate {
    $content = Get-Content -Path $UpdateScriptFile -Raw
    Register-LabUpdateTask -ScriptContent $content -TaskName $UpdateTaskName
    Write-LabLog 'Update-Task auf dem Exchange-Server registriert (laeuft nach dem Neustart).'

    try {
        $dcFqdn = "$DcComputerName.$DomainName"
        Invoke-Command -ComputerName $dcFqdn -ScriptBlock ${function:Register-LabUpdateTask} -ArgumentList $content, $UpdateTaskName, $true
        Write-LabLog "Update-Task auf $dcFqdn registriert und gestartet."
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Update-Task auf dem DC nicht registriert: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Invoke-InstallPhase {
    $secret = Get-InstallSecret
    $users = Initialize-LabDirectory -LabUserPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -String $secret.LabUserPassword -AsPlainText -Force)
    Install-Exchange
    Connect-ExchangeSession
    Initialize-ExchangeConfiguration -Users $users
    Register-InitialUpdate
}

#endregion

try {
    Write-LabLog "Start (Domain $DomainName, oeffentliche Domain $PublicDomainName)."
    switch ($Phase) {
        'Orchestrate' { Invoke-OrchestratePhase }
        'Install' {
            Invoke-InstallPhase
            Set-Content -Path $ResultFile -Value '0' -Encoding ASCII
        }
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Ende ohne Fehler.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    Write-LabLog $_.ScriptStackTrace
    if ($Phase -eq 'Install') {
        Set-Content -Path $ResultFile -Value '1' -Encoding ASCII
    }
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Installiert einmalig alle verfuegbaren Updates (Windows und Microsoft Update inkl. Exchange-SU).

.DESCRIPTION
    Wird nach der Exchange-Installation als Startup-Task (SYSTEM) auf DC und Exchange-Server registriert.
    Nutzt die Windows-Update-COM-API, registriert vorher den Microsoft-Update-Dienst (fuer Exchange-SUs).
    Startet bei Bedarf neu und laeuft dann erneut, maximal MaxRuns-mal. Danach entfernt sich der Task.
    Weitere Updates sind danach Aufgabe der Administratoren (Patch-Modus der VMs ist 'Manual').

    Das Skript enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string] $TaskName = 'ExchangeLab-InitialUpdates',

    [int] $MaxRuns = 4
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$CounterFile = Join-Path $LabRoot 'update-runs.txt'
$MicrosoftUpdateServiceId = '7971f918-a847-4430-9279-4a52d1efe18d'

New-Item -Path $LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir 'Update-LabServer.log'

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Unregister-UpdateTask {
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-LabLog "Task $TaskName entfernt."
}

try {
    $run = 1
    if (Test-Path -Path $CounterFile) {
        $run = [int](Get-Content -Path $CounterFile -Raw) + 1
    }
    Set-Content -Path $CounterFile -Value $run -Encoding ASCII
    if ($run -gt $MaxRuns) {
        Write-LabLog "Maximale Anzahl Durchlaeufe ($MaxRuns) erreicht."
        Unregister-UpdateTask
        exit 0
    }
    Write-LabLog "Update-Durchlauf $run von maximal $MaxRuns."

    $serviceManager = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.ServiceManager
    $registered = @($serviceManager.Services | Where-Object { $_.ServiceID -eq $MicrosoftUpdateServiceId })
    if (-not $registered) {
        $serviceManager.AddService2($MicrosoftUpdateServiceId, 7, '') | Out-Null
        Write-LabLog 'Microsoft-Update-Dienst registriert.'
    }

    $session = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session
    $searcher = $session.CreateUpdateSearcher()
    $searcher.ServerSelection = 3
    $searcher.ServiceID = $MicrosoftUpdateServiceId
    $searchResult = $searcher.Search("IsInstalled=0 and IsHidden=0 and Type='Software'")

    if ($searchResult.Updates.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-LabLog 'Keine ausstehenden Updates.'
        Unregister-UpdateTask
        exit 0
    }

    $updates = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.UpdateColl
    foreach ($update in $searchResult.Updates) {
        if (-not $update.EulaAccepted) {
            $update.AcceptEula()
        }
        Write-LabLog "Gefunden: $($update.Title)"
        $updates.Add($update) | Out-Null
    }

    $downloader = $session.CreateUpdateDownloader()
    $downloader.Updates = $updates
    $downloader.Download() | Out-Null

    $installer = $session.CreateUpdateInstaller()
    $installer.Updates = $updates
    $installResult = $installer.Install()
    Write-LabLog "Installation beendet, ResultCode $($installResult.ResultCode), Neustart erforderlich: $($installResult.RebootRequired)."

    if ($installResult.RebootRequired) {
        Write-LabLog 'Neustart in 60 Sekunden, danach naechster Durchlauf.'
        & shutdown.exe /r /t 60 /c 'ExchangeLab: Neustart nach Updates' /d p:2:17 | Out-Null
    }
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}
